## BGE-EN-ICL API

BGE-EN-ICL is an embedding model by BAAI, available on the Venice API as `text-embedding-bge-en-icl`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### BGE-EN-ICL API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text-embedding-bge-en-icl` | Standard | Private | $0.0125 / 1M tok |

### BGE-EN-ICL specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | BAAI |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Dimensions | 4,096 |
| Max input | 8K tokens |

### How to use the BGE-EN-ICL API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings` with `"model": "text-embedding-bge-en-icl"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "text-embedding-bge-en-icl",
    "input": "Private AI for everyone."
  }'
```
